note: Original copies of the Lua libraries. The game tooling copies a module (with its dependencies) into <game>/libs/. Inside a game the require path keeps the libs/ prefix. Exact functions: skill/libs-catalog.md.

modules.title: Finite state machine
modules.summary: new(initial); machine:add(from, event, to), :on(state, enter, exit), :fire(event), :get().

modules.title: Animator
modules.summary: Numeric tween: tween(target, from, to, duration_ms, ease) writes the eased value to target.value on :step(elapsed_ms); moves nothing itself. Needs libs/math/easing.

modules.title: UI
modules.summary: selector(items, opts) and confirm(question, opts), drawn with one shared Text line.

modules.title: Pre-game settings
modules.summary: new(spec) menu (Start plus choice/range rows) for three buttons; :input, :render, :destroy; labels are images under spec.kit; delivers the choices through spec.on_start(cfg).

modules.title: Test kit
modules.summary: expect, expect_eq, reg_sync, run_sync; reg_async only registers.

modules.title: Easing
modules.summary: linear, quad_in, quad_out, quad_inout, cubic_in, cubic_out, bounce_out: map t in [0..1].

modules.title: Lerp
modules.summary: lerp(a, b, t), clamp(v, lo, hi), map(v, in_lo, in_hi, out_lo, out_hi).

modules.title: Vec2
modules.summary: new(x, y); v:add, :sub, :scale (each a new vector), :len, :dot.
